keyFindings.description: checkArchitectureSource (line 196) proves the branch with GitHub.Ref, which reads GET /repos/{o}/{r}/commits/{ref} (githubapp/client.go:645-651) and resolves any commit-ish. On real GitHub (review App, sjawhar/legion) commits/main~1, commits/main^, commits/HEAD, commits/refs%2Fheads%2Fmain and commits/<40-hex sha> all answer a commit, while git/ref/heads/<value> answers 404 for each and refs/heads/main for main (and refs/heads/infra-391/architecture on sjawhar/legion-smoke, 404 for the prefix infra-391). The tester saved main~1, a SHA and refs/heads/<branch> through the server. A source saved on a SHA syncs once and never moves; one saved on main~1 tracks the wrong commit; Settings shows either as a branch. The check this PR adds, and its docs ('the branch exists in it'), promise an existing branch. Fix: the save accepts only an existing branch name and refuses a SHA, a relative ref or a refs/ path with 409 SOURCE_ACCESS (or 400 SOURCE_INPUT), writing nothing; an exact branch read (git/ref/heads/{branch} or branches/{branch}) is one mechanism; do not refuse a value only because it looks like a SHA, since a branch may have such a name. A test that fails at fa2dacfbb399 for at least a SHA and main~1, and the census section 6 updated. Sync's own use of Ref unchanged. Architect's ruling under dispatch://INFRA-49/ask/2d080aec-ce9a-4c7c-a235-ae998d2b0830.
